title: Build a Safe Search URL
question: Implement buildSearchUrl(base, query) so search text is safely encoded as a query parameter. Try spaces, ampersands, and non-English text.
constraints: Do not build the query by concatenating unescaped text.
hints: The URL API can parse a relative path when given a base address.
URLSearchParams.set encodes a query value safely.
optimized: Use URL and URLSearchParams instead of manual escaping.

discussion.whyAsked: Tests knowledge of browser URL tools and safe handling of user input.
discussion.mistakes: Concatenating values without encoding can change the meaning of the URL.
followUps: How would you preserve existing query parameters?
How should repeated filter values be represented?

title: Choose a Clear API UI State
question: Complete statusMessage(state) so each request state has a useful message, including empty results and failures.
exampleOutput: A distinct helpful message for each state.
constraints: Do not show a blank screen for empty or failed requests.
hints: Use an object whose keys are the possible states.
Give the empty state a next step the user can take.
optimized: Keep state labels and user-facing messages in one mapping.

discussion.whyAsked: Real interfaces need explicit loading, empty, success, and error states.
discussion.mistakes: Treating an empty result as an error or leaving the loading message visible.
followUps: How would you announce a changed message to a screen reader?

title: Choose a Cache Lifetime
question: Implement cacheLifetime(resource) to return a reasonable max-age in seconds for public hashed assets and frequently updated HTML.
exampleInput: Hashed asset and frequently updated HTML
constraints: Long caching is safe only when changed files receive new names. HTML may need revalidation.
hints: A content-hashed filename changes when its contents change.
Use a short lifetime or revalidation for HTML that points to current assets.
optimized: Tie long cache lifetimes to immutable, versioned asset URLs.

discussion.whyAsked: Caching is a tradeoff between speed and freshness.
discussion.mistakes: Applying a long public cache lifetime to personalized responses or unversioned files.
followUps: How can a CDN cache key vary by request?

title: Summarize Page Measurements
question: Implement labelForLcp(ms) to give a simple status for a Largest Contentful Paint measurement.
constraints: Treat the thresholds as product guidance, not a substitute for real-user analysis.
hints: Check the best range first, then the middle range.
The value is measured in milliseconds.
optimized: Keep threshold comparisons ordered and test boundary values.

discussion.whyAsked: Frontend engineers need to interpret real performance measurements.
discussion.mistakes: Comparing seconds to millisecond thresholds or checking ranges in the wrong order.
followUps: Why should field data be grouped by percentile?
What could delay the largest visible content?

title: Create a Semantic Contact Form
question: Build a small form with a visible label, email input, and submit button. Keep every control keyboard accessible.
initialCode:
<form>
  <!-- TODO: add a visible label and email field -->
  <button>Send</button>
</form>
solutionCode:
<form>
  <label for="email">Email address</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
exampleInput: A contact form with one email field
exampleOutput: The input has a visible, connected label and is keyboard usable.
constraints: Do not rely on placeholder text as the only label.
hints: Connect label for to the input id.
Use the correct input type for the information.

discussion.whyAsked: Semantic controls provide useful names and built-in keyboard behavior.
discussion.mistakes: Using a placeholder as a replacement for a label.
followUps: How would you present a validation error?
How would you announce a successful submission?
